title: Add external public disclosure brochure and changelog surfaces
createdBy: codex after chairman requested a brochure and changelog surface for external public disclosure

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-07-03: chairman requested a vacation-brochure style feature surface plus changelog for external public disclosure, distinct from internal PRD and CUJ surfaces.
historicalContent.description: Create a public-disclosure surface for Vaporize that can be reviewed externally without collapsing internal PRD, CUJ, launch-review, or claim-control boundaries. The surface must include a feature brochure and public changelog, remain evidence-bound, and preserve blocked release status until the public approval path completes.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize v0.0.1 has a public brochure artifact distinct from internal PRD and CUJ documents.
Vaporize v0.0.1 has a public changelog artifact distinct from internal PRD and CUJ documents.
Both public artifacts clearly state that they are draft public-disclosure surfaces and not publication approval.
Public claims in both artifacts stay within performance-marketing-claims.md.
release-gates.md names a public-disclosure gate for the brochure and changelog.
launch-review-packet.json references the public brochure, public changelog, and public-disclosure gate.
Release Doctor requires both public artifacts and checks launch-review public-disclosure references.
CUJ-09 and CUJ-17 focused tests fail if the public-disclosure surface is removed.
